Actually, looking at the union, `QuantNode` has `body` at a different offset than `base.body`. The `NODE_QUANT_BODY` macro is defined as `((node)->body)` which would access the `body` field of the `base` struct (since `Node` doesn't have a direct `body` member - it's inside the union).
